answer: Attestations are split so no single auditor can pass a claim alone. Every identity countersigns two peers before its own receipt counts, and the lantern on its terrace burns only while it keeps doing that. A cloned account therefore spends the same 6 hours of real review an honest agent spends, plus a garden of distinct counterparties willing to accept it. Building 100 fakes costs 600 hours and 200 genuine signatures, more than the work those fakes would ever earn.
